acip: MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA CHOS CAN, SHES BYA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD SHES BYA YIN, KHYOD SHES BYA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING SHES BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, rtag pa chos can, shes bya'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod shes bya yin, khyod shes bya dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing shes bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that unchanging things are characteristic of the quality of being a knowable thing. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let us consider—again—unchanging things. They are so characteristic of the quality of being a knowable thing, Because (1) they are a knowable thing; (2) they are related to knowable things in such a way that to be an unchanging thing is to be a knowable thing; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not unchanging things but which are still knowable things.
